title: SimpleTP
description: SimpleTP adds homes and teleportation to your Minecraft Paper server.
body:
SimpleTP is a Paper plugin that adds homes and teleportation features to your Minecraft server. Instead of installing multiple plugins for teleportation and homes, SimpleTP combines everything into one easy-to-use plugin.

The plugin also includes a clean teleportation UI and fully customizable settings in the config.yml file.

## Features

- Homes system
- TPA requests
- TPA Here requests
- Teleportation delay
- Fully customizable config.yml
- Custom sounds and messages
- Spawn system
- Easy to use

# Commands

## Player Commands

- /sethome <name> — Creates a home
- /home <name> — Teleports to a home
- /delhome <name> — Deletes a home
- /homes — Shows all your homes
- /tpa <player> — Sends a teleport request to a player
- /tpaccept — Accepts a teleport request
- /tpacancel — Cancels or declines a teleport request
- /tpahere <player> — Requests a player to teleport to you
- /tpatoggle — Enables or disables teleport requests

## Admin Commands

- /setnewspawn — Sets the server spawn
- /tp <player> — Teleports to a player instantly
- /tp2m <player> — Teleports a player to you instantly

## Compatibility

- Paper
- Minecraft 1.21.x+
